title: UNVERIFIED — Hall Before Ramp

features.name: the hall
features.desc-on-touch: Weatherboard. Four steps and a boot scraper. It says Bunyah on the side. There is no ramp yet. The request was specific about that.

features.name: the clock in the photograph
features.desc-on-touch: Stopped at ten twenty seven on the twenty eighth of December.

features.name: the chair with the green seat
features.desc-on-touch: Left beside the telephone, as instructed.

features.name: the gate
features.desc-on-touch: The chain goes through the gate, not round the post. The second washer is under the first.

features.name: an elbow at the edge of the frame
features.desc-on-touch: Hers. It came along with the hall.

inscription: I do not know if it is the hall anyone meant

file.name: Photo_Hall_Before_Ramp.jpg
file.note: Sent to /unverified in reply to request 00_051. Received. A tennis court resides next door.

reverie.title: REVERIE — outside a country hall
narr: You took the photograph years ago, without knowing what it was for.
A hall, four steps, a boot scraper. A tennis court next door.
She was beside you, just far enough out of frame
that only her elbow came with you.
Later, something asked for it. You closed your eyes and found it.
